what_it_is: Dossier is a New York print magazine about travel, culture and style, relaunched in 2024 after an earlier life as a fashion and art title. Each biannual issue is organised around places, from Bangkok and the Mekong countries to Madagascar and Palm Springs, and mixes long travel features, fashion stories shot on location, photography portfolios, short fiction and conversations with chefs, musicians, designers and writers. It is pitched at readers who want slow, luxury-leaning travel journalism with a strong cultural and literary bent.
